requirements.title: Manuscript Visual Placeholders
requirements.definition: Add visual placeholders within the applicable manuscript chapters to indicate where recommended images or graphics should appear.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers placement markers within the manuscript only; tracker maintenance and the explanatory strategy are independently deliverable and reviewable outputs.

requirements.title: Image Tracker Maintenance
requirements.definition: Update the image tracker for each applicable chapter group to reflect the visual-strategy recommendations.
requirements.boundary_note: The tracker is a distinct artifact that can be updated or reviewed independently from manuscript placeholders and chapter-level rationale.

requirements.title: Chapter Visual Strategy and Rationale
requirements.definition: Provide a high-level visual strategy for every applicable chapter that explains placement decisions, assesses which visuals should be retained, removed, repositioned, or added, identifies sourcing or permission needs, and recommends suitable image or graphic types where visuals are missing.
requirements.boundary_note: Retention, removal, repositioning, sourcing, permission, and later-creation recommendations are tightly coupled decision dimensions of one chapter-level strategy mechanism rather than separate deliverables; manuscript placeholders and tracker updates remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Strategy-Only Engagement Scope
requirements.definition: Limit the engagement to visual strategy and placement guidance, excluding final design, formatting, image sourcing, and graphic creation.
requirements.boundary_note: The excluded production services are attributes of one independently changeable engagement boundary rather than separate negative Requirements.
